crossRefs.note: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

parallels.note: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

translations.bsb: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.
translations.kjv: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
translations.asv: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? and not one of them shall fall on the ground without your Father:
